import random,json,subprocess,sys,time
random.seed(11)
def build_expr(atoms,depth):
    if depth<=0: return random.choice(atoms)
    op='and' if depth%2 else 'or'
    return {'op':op,'args':[build_expr(atoms,depth-1) for _ in range(2)]}
lines=[]
for rep in range(7):
    A=4; toks=[f"s{i}" for i in range(A)]
    random.seed(100+rep)
    pats=[[random.choice(toks) for _ in range(16)] for _ in range(8)]
    atoms=[{'op':'contains','path':p} for p in pats]
    req={'services':toks,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':build_expr(atoms,7)}],'queries':[[],toks]}
    lines.append(json.dumps(req))
payload=('\n'.join(lines)).encode()+b'\n'
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=payload,capture_output=True,timeout=170)
print("rc",p.returncode,"wall",round(time.time()-t,2),"outlines",len(p.stdout.decode().splitlines()),"stderr",p.stderr.decode()[:200])
